question: Where is the nearest restaurant when heading toward Forty Oaks, Clarkston, GA from Centennial High School Football Stadium, Roswell, GA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-84.292979 34.007322)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-84.234474 33.806684)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-84.292979 34.007322)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-84.292979 34.007322)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

answers.opening_hours: We-Sa 11:00-15:00 open "Lunch and Pizza/Bar Menu" || Fr-Sa 17:00-21:00 open "Dinner and Pizza/Bar Menu" || Fr-Sa 11:00-21:00, Su 11:00-20:00 open "Pizza/Bar Menu"; PH off

[2].display_name: Centennial High School Football Stadium, Roswell, GA
